text:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning a targeted engine hotspot swap tonight in the 02:00-04:00 UTC window. It's the quant-kernel v3.4.1 patch (perf + FP fallback). Need runbook + explicit rollback criteria. Deploybot will coordinate the slices.
cheng: +1. Which regions are in scope for the first wave?
maya: start with eu-west1 then us-central, asia follow if green. Staggered 10% -> 30% -> 60% traffic slices.
alex_k: Added a preflight checklist in the runbook draft. Key items: binary checksum, package signature, model-compat matrix, and KV cache sanity.
sam_g: Flagging thermal telemetry — last swap caused a perf tail in asia. We should gate on p95 GPU temp and eviction rate.
maya: Agreed. Primary gates: error_rate <= 0.5% for 15m, p50 latency delta <= +40ms, p95 GPU temp < 82C across hosts. If any gate trips we pause and rollback.
priya: Who's on rollback oncall? I'll be on-call until 03:30 UTC. If we need rollback, we need pin manifests and trigger deploybot revert.
release-coordinator: I'll draft short release notes and customer-facing blurb once we have the final cut. Need a 2-line summary and impact matrix.
cheng: Also want deploybot to annotate each step with metadata: build_sha, kernel_abi, quant_profile. That helps postmortem.
deploybot: preflight: checksums ok, infra quotas ok, canary manifests generated. tagging run: run/1755552500-engine-swap.
ops-bot: smoke-run started on eu-west1-canary instance. Logs streaming: https://logs.internal/1755552500
maya: Smoke check commands for ops:```bash
# run small generation smoke
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.local/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-770m-q4","prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq .
# tail runtime logs
kubectl -n runtime logs -l app=engine -c runtime --since=5m | tail -n 100
```
sam_g: If smoke passes, start 10% shard, monitor 5m, then promote. If any error >=0.5% or latency spike warn -> hold for triage.
alex_k: Adding explicit rollback step: pin engine image to previous stable sha (sha: abcdef1234) and revert routing via deploybot `rollback --tag previous`. Keep config intact.
priya: Also create a temporary holdback for targets using quant-profile 'aggressive' — we don't want those on night cut.
cheng: Telemetry hooks: enable detailed allocator traces for the first 10 instances for 20m. That should give us good signal without huge noise.
maya: Timeline: 01:45 UTC final signoff, 02:00 start eu canary (10%), 02:20 evaluate, 02:30 30%, 03:00 60% us-central start 10%. 03:30 review and decide asia.
release-coordinator: I'll put a short note in the release channel at 01:50 with the runbook link and rollback criteria.
deploybot: annotation: canary_started eu-west1 02:00 slice=10% build=3.4.1 sha=deadbeef kernel_abi=2.12
ops-bot: smoke ok on canary host, generation latency p50=72ms, error_rate=0.0% :thumbsup:
maya: If anything odd, ping me and @priya directly. Keep chatter to the thread to preserve context.
sam_g: A little reminder: if we decide to abort, do not mix rollback + hotpatch in same window. Pick one action and follow the runbook steps exactly.
priya: ack. I'll own the rollback ops if needed.
alex_k: After full promotion, I will trigger the release docs publish and update the model-compat matrix.
maya: Thanks all. See you in the window. :rocket:
